_access_token_note: access_token is OPTIONAL here and can be omitted entirely. It expires daily and is normally obtained via the UI's 'Login with Kite' button (see /kite/login-url + /kite/callback), which stores it in the database and survives restarts. A value here is only used as a one-time bootstrap if the database has no session yet.
_app_auth_secret_note: app_auth_secret is UNRELATED to Kite — it's this app's OWN front door (see app/auth.py). Required. Set it to a real password of your choosing; it's used both as the UI login password and as the X-API-Key value for scripted/curl access. Not the same thing as api_key/api_secret above, which are your Kite Connect app credentials.
_env_var_note: This whole file is the LOCAL-DEV-CONVENIENCE path. For anything server-hosted, api_key/api_secret/database_url/app_auth_secret can each be supplied instead as the environment variables KITE_API_KEY/KITE_API_SECRET/DATABASE_URL/APP_AUTH_SECRET — checked FIRST, config.json is only the fallback for whichever of those aren't set that way. config.json doesn't even need to exist if every one of the four is supplied via env var. See RUN_GUIDE.md's 'Credential hardening' section. Also: chmod 600 this file regardless of which path you use.
